long_description:
Manage your money like a Fortune 500 company, whether you are about to IPO or still working in a garage. Dealing with financial institutions is painful. Yet it’s critical to keep your corporate cash safe & earning a reasonable rate of return. InterPrime helps you do that.

InterPrime helps you
1. Keep your cash safe
2. Earn a reasonable rate of return on your money
3. Assure your investors that you will responsibly steward their capital

More details at www.interprime.co
name: InterPrime
